name: Shizuki Yuri
source: A polite and quite girl with black hair, Yuri is the president of her class and also the tea ceremony class's chairman and manager. She is rather timid, but has a rather well - developed and sensitive body. After being molested and raped on the train her molesters steal her clothing forcing her to arrive at school wearing nothing but thigh high socks and a ribbon around her neck. This happens so often over the course of several weeks that nobody listens to her anymore thinking she's doing it herself because she's a pervert, nobody cares to help her any longer, and her teachers and the police simply make her attend school naked where she is further molested and raped.
